tools.name: check_site
tools.description: Run a free Tuper Site Check on a public website (measured in a real browser): returns a 0-100 score, counts by severity, the top 5 problems (what, why it matters, where) and the full report URL. Takes 20-90 s. If still running after wait_seconds, returns status "running" and an id for get_report.

tools.name: check_agent_ready
tools.description: Run a free Tuper Agent-Ready Check on a public website: can AI agents reach, read and use it? Checks robots.txt rules for 12 AI bots (answer bots scored, training bots info only), llms.txt (llmstxt.org format), bot walls and captchas on the sign-up/login/contact pages, text only after JavaScript, si

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: Read a Site Check report by id (from check_site): status (queued, running, done, error), and when done the score, the top findings (up to 20 with all=true) and the report URL.
